name: @gjsify/web-worker
description: WHATWG Worker for GJS (and Node) over worker_threads — new Worker(url), postMessage, terminate, onmessage/onerror, with a DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope-shaped scope inside the worker. Works with Comlink unmodified.

scripts.clear: gjsify clear lib tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.types.tsbuildinfo fixtures test.gjs.mjs test.node.mjs
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:gjs && gjsify run build:test:node
scripts.build:test:gjs: gjsify run prebuild:test:fixtures && gjsify build src/bundled-fixtures/comlink.worker.mjs --app gjs --outfile fixtures/comlink.worker.bundle.mjs && gjsify build src/test.mts --app gjs --outfile test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build:test:node: gjsify run prebuild:test:fixtures && gjsify build src/bundled-fixtures/comlink.worker.mjs --app node --outfile fixtures/comlink.worker.bundle.mjs && gjsify build src/test.mts --app node --outfile test.node.mjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs
scripts.test:gjs: gjsify run build:test:gjs && gjsify run test.gjs.mjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
